summary: Projected from workspace.dsl + invariants.yaml for change 'add-notification-module': 3 module(s), 1 dependency edge(s), 2 constraint(s).

modules.responsibility: Own available stock per SKU; expose stock read/adjust operations.
Own hold-expiry notification delivery (channel, formatting, retry).
Own hold lifecycle (reserve/release/expire/lookup) and TTL/authZ enforcement.

dependencies.reason: Reads hold-expiry events to notify the holder.

constraints.reason: Stock ownership must stay independent of hold/TTL/authZ concerns so inventory can be reused (e.g. multi-warehouse) without carrying reservation logic.
Hold lifecycle rules must not depend on notification delivery mechanics, so reservation stays usable/testable without a notification channel configured.
